name: mx.com.petify/ai-connect
title: Petify AI Connect
description: Public Mexican pet commerce, services and editorial knowledge from Petify.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search across public Petify products, services and editorial resources. Returns canonical links and source text.

query.description: Search terms, in Spanish or original language; for best coverage include localized Spanish terms in query_es.

query_es.description: Optional equivalent Spanish search terms. Preserve brand and model.

language.description: Requested BCP 47 language (e.g. en, es-MX, zh-CN, ja, pt-BR, ar).

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one public record by ID returned by search.

id.description: Opaque record ID from search, e.g. product:123

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Mexican product offers, preserving separate seller offers and recorded availability.

query.description: Search terms, in Spanish or original language; for best coverage include localized Spanish terms in query_es.

query_es.description: Optional equivalent Spanish search terms. Preserve brand and model.

language.description: Requested BCP 47 language (e.g. en, es-MX, zh-CN, ja, pt-BR, ar).

tools.name: compare_offers
tools.description: Compare explicit product offer IDs. Does not assume different pack sizes or products are equivalent.

items.description: Opaque record ID from search, e.g. product:123

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search published pet services in Mexico. Location is a text filter, not a verified distance or live schedule.

query.description: Search terms, in Spanish or original language; for best coverage include localized Spanish terms in query_es.

query_es.description: Optional equivalent Spanish search terms. Preserve brand and model.

language.description: Requested BCP 47 language (e.g. en, es-MX, zh-CN, ja, pt-BR, ar).

query.description: Search terms, in Spanish or original language; for best coverage include localized Spanish terms in query_es.

query_es.description: Optional equivalent Spanish search terms. Preserve brand and model.

language.description: Requested BCP 47 language (e.g. en, es-MX, zh-CN, ja, pt-BR, ar).

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Get source policies, coverage and API discovery links.

tools.name: ask_petia
tools.description: Consult PetiA in any supported model language, grounded in public records. Requires a provisioned bearer token; no customer data.

query_es.description: Optional equivalent Spanish search terms. Preserve brand and model.

language.description: Requested BCP 47 language (e.g. en, es-MX, zh-CN, ja, pt-BR, ar).
